annotations.title: How relevant a connection is to your goal

description: Job Spotter. How relevant a connection is to your goal. For "should I connect with this person?", "is she worth messaging?". Scores how relevant a connection is to the user's goal, out of 100, from two profiles the user provides (it rates the fit with the goal, not the person), the same way every time: works where they want to work, recruiter or likely hiring manager for the goal, same school, same past employer, shared skills, nearby, more senior. Gives the reasons, a short verdict and an outline for a short note. Profiles can be pasted text (for example from LinkedIn's Save to PDF). Nothing sent is stored.

goal.description: What the person is aiming for, for example "data analyst at Monzo".

me.description: A profile: text, and or fields title, company, past_companies, schools, location, skills.
